gaps: WP XACT PRO for Japanese bikes: only the Kawasaki KX250/450 7548/8950 set (already ss-006/007) and a Honda launch (wp-group news page blocked). No WP part numbers or fitment found for Yamaha, Suzuki or Triumph; a WP Cone Valve/Trax set was tested on the 2019 YZ450F only (outside app years). No WP Cone Valve or Trax product for any Japanese mini.
Showa A-kit for minis (KX85/KX112/CRF150R): none found. Showa A-kit for Yamaha/Suzuki/Triumph: none found.

KYB factory kits for KX65, KX85, KX112 and CRF150R: no complete kit fork/shock found (only a KYB A-kit cartridge for CR85/CRF150/RM85 with no years). KYB kit for TF 450-X and for 2024+ KX450 fork not found.
Öhlins: no product for any 65/85/112/150 mini. No Öhlins part confirmed for RM-Z450 shock, CRF250R 2020-21 or 2024+, YZ250F 2023+ shock beyond existing DMX 0221, or KX250 2024.

Race Tech: big-bike Gold Valve kits (SMGV 4603/5003, FMGV S-series) list makes only, not models/years, on every page reached; not entered. G3-S shock has no model list or prices ('$call'). Race Tech SMGV 3301 fits KX65 only to 2016. FMGV 2040 fits YZ85 only to 2019. No Race Tech YZ65 or KX65 shock kit for 2020+ found.
MX-Tech: no current product for Japanese bikes found (Blackjack is WP-only, already ss-046); MXT/SFF conversion test was on 2013-14 bikes.
Technical Touch: only the WP-to-KYB kit (KTM group) found; no Japanese-bike kit with fitment.

AOMC: sells parts (Race Tech springs, WP) but no AOMC revalve service page found. TBM: no suspension product found. Luxon: no Japanese mini or Triumph suspension parts found beyond clamps already in ss-021..023.
Pro Circuit: KX65/85 pull rods (KPR00065) fit KX65 only to 2018 per dealer; no 2020+ years stated, so not entered. Pro Circuit worksheets for KX65 06-24 and KX85/100 14-24 failed to load.
Factory Connection: springs found for 80-150cc Japanese minis but not KX65 or YZ65; no published FC revalve prices.
No rider/tester feedback found for any small-bike kit (KYB YZ65/YZ85 kits, Krooztune, K-Tech ORVS).
Enzo bladder cap ER-BC54RC is listed for 2019 Yamaha YZF only (outside app years); not entered.
